observed_semantic_constraints.constraint: Entity update loops reload array length after each update; appended entities may run in the same tick. Snapshot iteration is not equivalent without further invariants.
Terminated entities are filtered after an entity-list update pass, retaining relative order. Termination alone does not skip an update within that pass.
Entity-list processing follows enity_list_name; updates cannot be parallelized without establishing independence.

Team sorting comparator can return positive for both argument orders when slot configuration is absent or zero. Reference JS runtime and sorting behavior must be identified before replacing this sort.
